purpose: Provide a private, accessible, deterministic workbench for the 13 unresolved confirmatory-protocol decisions, including explicit options, tradeoffs, dependencies, required evidence, and a blank selection template without allowing repository-generated recommendations or readiness claims.

decision_scope.source_rule: Decision labels, categories, owner roles, and blocking status must match the frozen parent protocol_decision_register.csv exactly.
decision_scope.default: All 13 selections remain unresolved and blank. No option receives a recommended, preferred, default, green, or automatically selected label.
decision_scope.separation: Completing a selection worksheet does not substantively verify evidence and can never by itself set RecruitmentReady=true.

option_catalog_contract.anti_recommendation: Every option has AutoSelectable=false and RecommendationStatus=not_recommended_by_repository. Option order is not a rank.

dependency_contract.sample_size_guard: SCI-02 cannot resolve or accept a numeric value until its seven registered prerequisites resolve prospectively.
dependency_contract.acyclic: The registered dependency graph must be acyclic and every prerequisite must precede its dependent stage.

selection_template_contract.resolution_rule: A resolved row requires an option belonging to that decision, all prerequisites resolved, nonblank rationale/assumption/owner evidence, DecisionRecordedBeforeOutcomes=true, HumanOutcomesInspectedBeforeDecision=false, and RepositoryGeneratedSelectionAllowed=false.
selection_template_contract.numeric_rule: Options marked RequiresNumericInput require a finite positive value, unit, and assumption-set reference.
selection_template_contract.external_rule: Options requiring external authority need a nonblank external evidence reference and EvidenceSource not beginning repository_generated.
selection_template_contract.readiness_rule: Even a synthetically complete and schema-valid worksheet reports SelectionsComplete=true but SubstantiveEvidenceVerified=false and RecruitmentReady=false.

private_workbench_contract.html: Self-contained UTF-8 HTML with no external scripts, fonts, stylesheets, forms, or network resources. It leads with BLOCKED / 募集不可, shows dependency stages, and presents all options in source order without ranking.
private_workbench_contract.archive: Deterministic lexicographically ordered ZIP with fixed timestamps/permissions, SHA-256 manifest, zero human rows, and blocked-first-read tamper detection.
private_workbench_contract.surface: Private offline artifact only; no Streamlit route, public evidence button, writable form, or external message is created.

cases: 39 options cover every decision exactly three times with no recommendation/default
dependency graph is acyclic and sample-size/recruitment/ethics stages cannot resolve early
default blank selection template is schema-valid but incomplete and blocked
resolved decision without prerequisites, rationale, owner evidence, or prospective lock fails
numeric option without positive value/unit/assumption reference fails
external option with repository-generated evidence fails
synthetic fully completed worksheet may be selection-complete but remains recruitment-blocked
HTML is self-contained, bilingual, option-complete, non-form, and blocked
bundle bytes reproduce and HTML/manifest tampering fails validation

automated_success_gates.identity: Every parent hash matches before execution.
automated_success_gates.catalog: Exactly 39 options match the registered ids/fields and none is recommended, ranked, defaulted, or auto-selectable.
automated_success_gates.dependencies: Exactly 13 dependency rows match the graph, are acyclic, and respect stages.
automated_success_gates.selection: Default 13-row template is exact, blank, schema-valid, incomplete, and recruitment-blocked; registered synthetic invalid cases fail with expected codes.
automated_success_gates.html: Self-contained HTML includes every decision/option, blocked bilingual first read, protocol content SHA, no form controls, and no external resources.
automated_success_gates.bundle: Seven exact members, deterministic bytes, correct hashes, zero human rows, and tamper rejection pass.
automated_success_gates.human_gate: HumanParticipants=0, OptionsSelected=0, SelectionsComplete=false, SubstantiveEvidenceVerified=false, RecruitmentReady=false, MinimumValidPerCellRegistered=false, PlannedRecruitmentNSelected=false, ConfirmatoryResultAvailable=false, and PublicSurfaceEnabled=false.
automated_success_gates.tests: New workbench tests plus selected protocol, dependence, planning, gate, operations, comprehension, one-click, archive, and decision-stability tests pass.

interpretation_limits.options: Catalogued options are not exhaustive, equally appropriate, validated, or recommended. External scientific and institutional owners may require a prospective amendment before adding or changing options.
interpretation_limits.impact: Qualitative impact labels are decision aids, not effect-size or cost estimates.
interpretation_limits.evidence: References in a worksheet are not substantively verified by this workbench.
interpretation_limits.ethics: Only appropriate independent and institutional authorities can approve ethics, consent, recruitment, privacy, and governance.
interpretation_limits.statistics: No numeric n is selected and no option is promoted by prior synthetic outcomes.
